posts.caption: He asked her out. His roommates wrote the text.
His roommate texted his crush as him. Part 2
She asked: are you the one writing these texts? Part 3
She found a ring box in his drawer. Part 1

My neighbour swipes at 2 AM too. Part 1

We made rules for talking through windows. Part 3
Her roommate doesn't swipe. At all. Part 4
Her window filled up with boxes. Part 5
She moved out. Then she showed up at 10am. Part 6

I asked for her number. I didn't know her name. Part 3
I told her she'd find someone. Wrong move. Part 4
She said yes to Thursday. Then she didn't show. Part 5

She didn't show. I left one last note. Part 6. 9:40 and dryer 5 was still empty. So I stayed and wrote her one last note. The finale. Thanks for every A and B. #shortstory #romance #animation #tinyloveshows #finale
